name: Egg Lake
summary: Becker County Fire Tower 58, a CCC-built 81-foot Aermotor ladder tower from 1935 in the northern Tamarac refuge; FFLA marks it gone with no removal date.
status_note: The FFLA list marks it Tower Gone with no date; the county list uses the past tense and gives no removal date
agency: Minnesota Forest Service, now the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources

access.note: Tamarac National Wildlife Refuge is open to visitors and its visitor center is open seasonally; no source says whether the tower site is marked or reachable

visit.trail_note: The county list also mentions a trail to the site and describes the walk as pleasant, especially in the fall; the list is undated

events.note: Erected by the Civilian Conservation Corps as an 81-foot Aermotor ladder tower, under the Park Rapids forestry station
Tamarac National Wildlife Refuge established by Executive Order 7902, dated May 31, 1938
